messages:
lina-support: FYI Acme support case - they're seeing a sharp p99 jump on /v1/chat since ~03:00 UTC. p95 stable ~250ms, p99 ~1.2s (was ~420ms). Customer running rwd-7b quantized, region eu-west-1. They sent 2 request_ids: req_aa12, req_bb34.

omar-sre: Do we have a recent kernel/compileflag rollout to that prod pool? any SDPA/Flash toggles in last 6h?

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: attn-kernel/optimize-flags v2026-03-16T02:30 completed on pool eu-west-1-canary (id: c-42).

maria-ml: We pushed an optimization compile flag (enable-sdpa-heuristic=true) in the canary window around 02:30. It flips kernel selection heuristics to prefer SDPA for short/batched sequences.

jay-eng: Repro steps I used locally: curl to hosted endpoint with short 8-token prompts, concurrency 16. I can reproduce p99 jump on canary config. Command: 
```bash
ab -n 1000 -c 16 -T application/json -p payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
# payload.json uses model: rwd-7b, max_tokens: 64
```
Logs show kernel decision toggling to sdpa_v2 for a subset of shards: 
"kernel_selected=sdpa_v2" 
"latency_ms=1200" for some calls, others 300ms.

elena-cs: Acme is on a dedicated contract and wants an ETA — they're sensitive to p99 for interactive features.

omar-sre: Short-term mitigation: flip SDPA heuristic to prefer flash fallback on that pool or disable sdpa_v2 for rwd-7b in eu-west-1. I can run a runtime toggle. That should drop p99 immediately but may increase cost. 

jay-eng: Agreed. Also we should confirm whether compile flag or kernel selection causes regression: is it SDPA producing tail latency due to buffer-copy path? Maria, can you check perf traces on canary?

maria-ml: Traces show SDPA path hitting a slow path when sequence length distribution mixes very short + occasional long requests; we get extra memcpy + kernel relaunch causing tail jitter. I'll attach a short flame snippet to the ticket.

omar-sre: Applying quick mitigation now: 
```bash
redwoodctl runtime toggle --pool eu-west-1-prod --model rwd-7b --kernel sdpa_v2 --state off --reason "p99 regression, revert sdpa selection"
```
I'll monitor p99 in the next 5 mins.

deploy-bot: run: redwoodctl toggle job started (job id j-99321).

lina-support: I messaged Acme: "we're investigating and have applied a temporary mitigation; we'll update in 10m" :eyes:

om ar-sre: (typo) > omar-sre: p99 dropped to ~430ms within 90s after toggle on a subset of hosts. Rolling out to remainder of pool in 2m.

jay-eng: Good. Next step: we can either roll back the optimization (disable the compile flag) or improve SDPA's short-sequence fast path to avoid memcpy. Maria, what's estimate for a quick patch?

maria-ml: I can prepare a minimal SDPA guard in ~3-6 hours (patch + canary). Rollback of compile flag is fastest (<=30m) and less risky.

elena-cs: Customer asked for a play-by-play. I posted to the ticket: "Mitigation applied (SDPA disabled for model), monitoring shows p99 back to baseline. Engineering investigating root cause. Will follow up with timeline."

omar-sre: Action list: 1) keep SDPA disabled on rwd-7b eu-west-1 prod until root cause fix, 2) rollback compile flag from canary/unified rollout config, 3) schedule postmortem to tune kernel-selection heuristics, 4) add regression alert on kernel selection p99 delta. I'm creating related ops tasks.

jay-eng: I'll do the rollback of the compile flag in canary and coordinate with infra to prevent auto-rollout. Command I'll run: 
```bash
redwoodctl config set --scope canary --key attn.opt.enable-sdpa-heuristic=false --reason "p99 regression rollback"
```
Then monitor canary for 30m before promoting.

maria-ml: I'll start a perf repro job to capture SDPA vs flashattn traces and post findings to the ticket (including small flamegraphs and a few kernel traces).

elena-cs: Customer update: "Thanks — they see immediate improvement and asked for confirmation when the fix is permanent."

lina-support: Note for postmortem: we need better canary gating metric for kernel tail latency, not just average token throughput. Add to follow-up.

omar-sre: Confirmed last: last_message p99 stabilized. I'll keep the SDPA toggle in place until Maria's patch or we safely rollback the optimization.

jay-eng: Follow-ups: create an RFC to add explicit kernel-selection unit tests and a synthetic workload that mimics mixed short/long sequences; assign to eng-runtime + ml infra.

elena-cs: Closing loop with Acme: they want a short summary and timeline; I'll send once we have rollback + fix ETA.

lina-support: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll document the mitigation steps in the support playbook and mark the case resolved once the long-term fix is in staging.
